candidate_1.important_qualification: The catalogue's three Hebrew translations must not be described as three complete preserved text witnesses. Nonofficial search snippets suggested one translation is fragmentary; those snippets were not adopted as the source or used for substantive reading. Exact witnesses, dates, completeness and editorial interventions require the actual authorized introduction/apparatus.
unpaid_source_contract: Choose and identify an exact edition/witness, and confirm the complete intended work span rather than amalgamating translations.
Read the editor's treatment of orthography, word division, abbreviations, corrections, lacunae and supplied text before using its printed strings.

Keep a modern critical edition's reconstructed spelling distinct from the physical writing of any one medieval scribe; a digital Hebrew string is not automatically a diplomatic transcription or a22-sign channel.
A full language's learned vocabulary, morphology and contextual ambiguity remain actual reading costs; a medical subject label cannot supply missing word meanings or sentence boundaries.
candidate_1.selection_status: Most specific acquisition lead of the two; not ready for a writer or frequency test. Only a bounded inspection of the actual edition introduction, sigla and complete first Hebrew text could change that source-access decision.

candidate_2.wellcome_finding: The catalogue title explicitly identifies an introduction with selected aphorisms from the Hebrew work. This is not evidence of a complete Hebrew transcription.
candidate_2.nlm_finding: MS C294 holds the1971 Muntner/Rosner English translation in two volumes. The finding aid says onsite physical storage and materials primarily in English. It does not expose a complete Hebrew online transcription.
candidate_2.catalogue_caution: The combined NLM collection abstract labels both holdings as13th-century Arabic treatises and is itself marked Unverified Partial Draft. Do not use that combined catalogue description to assign a date or original language to Asaf; only the particular holding/access facts are used here.
candidate_2.selection_status: No inspected complete Hebrew transcription or controllable historical sign/space contract. A full English translation, selected Hebrew aphorisms and manuscript images would be different source products; none can silently substitute for the requested full Hebrew writing counterpart.
